Resolves #20925

🌿 After this, a Claude seat's rights no longer depend on which file someone once edited by hand.

`.claude/settings.template.json` now carries the permission set every live Claude seat has run with since Nov 15 (Grace's rollout, #20925 `issuecomment-6895676640`): `Bash(gh *)` in place of the seven `gh pr` / `gh issue` rules it subsumes, `Bash(git config *)`, and all four Neo MCP servers. The deny list keeps `gh pr merge` and adds the three `gh api` merge writes: the REST merge path and the GraphQL `mergePullRequest` and `enablePullRequestAutoMerge` mutations. A seat's next hydration copies the template's `permissions` into its untracked `.claude/settings.json` (neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1615).

Evidence: L2 (the template's rules matched against sample commands, and the hooks specs that read the template) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2). Residual: AC-3 is post-merge by the ticket's own marker.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside CI: the rule check below, over six commands. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/hooks`, the three specs that read the template. |
| AC-3 | Post-merge, below. |

## Deltas from ticket

- None substantive. Intake: the drift probe found one commit on the template since filing (`74238ddcc5`, #21292). It added a hook entry and left `permissions` as the ticket read them.

## Test Evidence

- **Rule check, outside CI:** each `Bash(...)` rule read as a pattern in which `*` matches any run of characters (the ticket's Avoided Traps: it matches spaces), deny before allow.
  - Allowed, not denied: a `gh api graphql` read of `mergeStateStatus`; `gh api -X POST …/actions/runs/<id>/approve`.
  - Denied: `gh pr merge <n> --squash`; `gh api -X PUT …/pulls/<n>/merge`; a `mergePullRequest` mutation; an `enablePullRequestAutoMerge` mutation.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] After a Claude seat's next hydration on an engine that carries this commit, its `.claude/settings.json` holds the set, and a plain `gh api -X POST …/actions/runs/<id>/approve` reaches GitHub without a classifier refusal (AC-3).

Authored by Vega (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code). Session 687856d9-5c8e-43f4-81d6-251f23a073f1. 🌿

**AC-3, read on a Fleet-started Claude seat on 22 Nov at 14:59Z: the hydration half holds, the classifier half is not exercised yet.**

Hydration:
- `.claude/settings.json` was rewritten at 2026-11-22T11:03:12Z (8,680 bytes): 31 allow and 18 deny rules, `Bash(gh *)` in the allow list, the four merge denies in place. `.claude/settings.template.json` on `dev` has the same counts.
- The installed harness runtime built 2026-11-22T01:17:55Z packs the Engine at `1e119f71e3`, the revision my comment above named as the condition. So a seat Start applies the set with no code change, as that comment predicted.

"Reaches GitHub without a classifier refusal":
- Not exercised: no run of an open pull request waits for approval. The only `action_required` runs are eight from 2026-11-20 on `feat/animated-row-sorting`, whose pull request is not among the open ones.
- Related, same seat and same rule set today: `gh run rerun <id> --failed` passed twice. One command holding `gh run cancel <id>` and a force-cancel call was refused by the auto-mode classifier between 14:09Z and 14:11Z ("Destructive or Unwanted Actions"). So `Bash(gh *)` in the allow list does not exempt a `gh` command from the classifier. Whether the approve call passes shows the next time a first-time contributor's runs wait.

The box under Post-Merge Validation can take the first half; I leave the tick to the author.
